dataset: PhotoTourism IMC-PT 2020 / Trevi Fountain with NeRF-W image membership
camera_provenance: Reuse supplied IMC-PT dense/sparse COLMAP cameras and sparse points; all-view SfM provenance; per-image intrinsics retained, no fresh pose estimation
scale: Uncalibrated reconstruction units; align and establish meters before physics
attribution: Snavely et al., Photo Tourism, SIGGRAPH 2006; IMC-PT 2020 collection; Martin-Brualla et al., NeRF-W, CVPR 2021 split; original photographer rights apply
release: IMC-PT 2020 trevi_fountain.tar.gz; NeRF-W selected_images/trevi.tsv; hashes recorded at download
mask_policy: Unmasked smoke baseline; review generated landmark masks before a production candidate

split.policy: Keep official test membership; carve validation from official training images; exclude unlisted images; project full-image evaluation, not official appearance-adapted benchmark

license: Check source dataset and original photographer terms; no blanket image redistribution permission assumed
